title: fix: avoid duplicate image edit safety checks
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Applies image-edit input safety only on the public request; detached replay parses the already-safe normalized body.
- Preserves cache identity, edit parameters, and executor input without flags or new state.
- Tests: `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-gen`; `npx vitest run test/openai-image-cache.test.ts`

gist.headline: Safety Check, Once
gist.blurb: Image edits now pass through the safety garden once, then carry their clean little passport through replay. Same cache identity, same edit settings, fewer unnecessary laps around the hive.
gist.summary: Fixed the OpenAI-compatible image-edit route so input safety runs on the public request only, while detached cache replays parse the already-safe normalized body without rechecking it.
gist.impact: Image-edit requests now retain their cache identity, edit parameters, and executor input across detached replays while avoiding duplicate safety processing.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy image-edit workshop where Polli stamps a single green safety approval onto a picture before it travels along a cached replay conveyor; a retro CRT robot receives the already-approved image without asking for another stamp. The single passport/stamp and looping-but-skipped conveyor make the one-time safety check and preserved replay identity visible, with code-plants and flowers grounding it in the pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden workshop: The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny inspector cap and stamps one lime green (#ecf874) "SAFE" pixel passport onto an image-edit card, while a cute chunky CRT-monitor robot happily receives the already-stamped card from a short replay conveyor with no second checkpoint. Code-plants, pixel flowers, and a softly glowing terminal surround them; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
